scope.accepted: Standard resource27/index0/kind4/units12..17/keyflag0. Actual chosen AI command, unit IDs/positions/viewport, original before-draw indexed/RGBA16x16 base, native AND/OR explicit white clears, cumulative erase and real timer/copy/display stamps. Two original transparent HD swords stay within certified16x16; outside remains actual current LCD.
limitations: Real observed command types are recorded per run; fixture STGM U16 coverage does not establish actual browser skill-branch coverage.

Runtime base comes from actual native before-draw observer and is checked with independently read native palette. Full first-base and LCD behavior are independently verified in compiled actual C; runtime has no separate pre-draw whole-screen snapshot.
Only default scale1 160x96, standard LIB and PC1080p/720p are accepted.

Resource27 upgrade/death0..11, full HD battlefield positioning, other skills,28 remaining attack combinations, arbitrary Mods, complete campaign matrix, fixed-device performance, mobile and cloud remain pending.

art.processing: Original generated PNG bytes copied unchanged, original alpha preserved; no external editing.
